# mybookmark

> A curated book subscription library with doorstep delivery in Bengaluru, India.

## About

mybookmark is a subscription-based book library serving readers across Bengaluru. Members subscribe to a monthly plan, browse a catalogue of 1 lakh+ titles, and get books delivered to their doorstep. No late fees, unlimited swaps, and 100% refundable deposits.

## Website

- Homepage: https://mybookmark.in

- Shipping & Delivery Policy: https://mybookmark.in/shipping
- Privacy Policy: https://mybookmark.in/privacy
- Terms & Conditions: https://mybookmark.in/terms

## Current Offer

6th and 12th month FREE for all monthly subscribers. Subscribe to any monthly plan and your 6th month and 12th month subscription fee is waived completely. Limited time offer.

## Plans

- Kids Plan: ₹249/month, 1 book at a time, age-tagged catalogue (3-12 years), refundable deposit ₹400
- Reader Plan: ₹549/month, 4 books at a time, full catalogue access, refundable deposit ₹1,000
- Bookworm Plan: ₹849/month, 6 books at a time, priority delivery, refundable deposit ₹1,500
- Founder Plan: ₹400/month, 4 books at a time, early supporter pricing, refundable deposit ₹1,000

All plans include: 6th and 12th month FREE for monthly subscribers.

## Catalogue

1 lakh+ titles across genres: Fiction, Indian Fiction, Non-fiction, Self-help, Business, Psychology, Finance, Science, Biography, Thriller, Sci-fi, Classics, Kids, Young Adult.

Popular titles include: Atomic Habits, Sapiens, The Midnight Library, Educated, Ikigai, Rich Dad Poor Dad, The Alchemist, Thinking Fast and Slow, and more.

## How It Works

1. Sign up and choose a plan
2. Browse the catalogue and request books
3. Books are delivered to your door (Bengaluru-wide)
4. Read at your pace, swap anytime
5. No late fees, no due dates

## PS5 Rental Service

mybookmark also rents PlayStation 5 consoles in Bengaluru with doorstep delivery:
- Weekend Plan (Fri-Sun): ₹3,500 + ₹10,000 refundable deposit
- Weekly Plan (7 days): ₹5,500 + ₹10,000 refundable deposit
- Monthly Plan (30 days): ₹15,000 + ₹10,000 refundable deposit

Includes: PS5 console, 4 DualSense controllers, PS Plus subscription, free setup and pickup.

- Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada

## Shipping & Delivery

- Doorstep delivery across all of Bengaluru
- Regular delivery day: Wednesdays
- Delivery charges: ₹40-₹80 per trip (varies by locality, communicated before each delivery)
- First delivery: 2-5 business days from signup
- Swap delivery: 2-3 business days from request
- PS5 delivery: 1-2 business days, free delivery and pickup included
- Pay-on-delivery model: subscription fee + deposit collected at first delivery, not online

## Refund & Cancellation Policy

- Cancel anytime, no lock-in, no cancellation fees
- 100% refundable security deposit returned within 7 working days after books returned and audited
- Damage charge: 50% of book cover price for lost/severely damaged books, deducted from deposit
- Mid-cycle cancellation: remaining days not refunded, subscription ends at cycle end
- Pay-on-delivery model: no upfront online charges, pay only when book is in hand
- No GST currently charged
